propositions: Pydantic-ai 1.107.2 successfully constructs OpenAIResponsesModel for openai-responses: prefix, and all wire protocol behaviors (structured output, streaming, tool calls, retries, custom base_url routing) are identical between openai-chat: and openai-responses: under the pinned SDK

Rebar today blocks openai-responses: routing at four production-construction sites: KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES omits the prefix, _pydantic_ai_known_providers derives from known_model_names() which has no openai-responses entries, _PROFILE_RESOLVERS lacks openai-responses key, and openai: normalizers hard-code Chat Completions

Contract tests in tests/unit/test_openai_responses_contract.py construct real pydantic-ai models via provider_factory injection (no mocks of infer_model), parameterized over both prefixes, exercising structured output, streaming, tool calls, 429 retry surface, and custom-base-URL path routing

Custom base_url endpoints (LMStudio/Ollama/vLLM/LiteLLM) via _build_openai are Chat-Completions-only because the builder is keyed only on openai/openai-chat and never reaches openai-responses: strings

Vendor-side native /v1/responses support for deepseek, groq, xai, cerebras, moonshot, heroku, and local servers remains UNKNOWN due to no live API calls and incomplete optional dependency coverage under the pinned toolchain
